info.title: Izgubljene živali API
info.description: Lost pet finder REST API. Every error body is `ApiErrorBody` with a stable code (contract C1).

AdminQueues.description: available is false while pg-boss has not created its tables yet.

AdminUser.description: No phone; the email is masked (a***@example.si).

ApiErrorBody.description: Body of every error response (C1); clients map `code` to `errors.<code>`.

AuditLogEntry.description: actor_id is null for system actions; diff.note is the staff note.

CachedReport.description: Report fields the mobile offline cache keeps (C17).

FailedJob.description: No payload (it may hold personal data), only the error message.

MatchReason.description: Why two reports match: bands and overlaps only, never exact data.

Message.description: Chat message; rendered as plain text, links never linkified.

Pet.description: Owner view of a pet profile.

PublicConfig.description: Public app_config flags by key, e.g. { "vet_partner.enabled": false }.

PublicReport.description: Public read model of a report (fuzzed area, no contact or chip data).

ReportOwnerView.description: PublicReport plus the fields only a manager of the report sees.

get.description: Moderators and admins (aal2). query matches the display name or the email; emails are masked, no phone (C3). Audited.

200.description: One page of users, newest first

put.description: Admins (aal2). The note is required and stored in the audit entry; the last admin cannot be demoted (CONFLICT). Takes effect on the next request of the user.

get.description: Admins (aal2). Staff and system actions, newest first, with exact-match filters. Audited.
Admins (aal2). pg-boss jobs per queue and state, and the latest failed jobs (error message only). Read-only; audited.
The caller’s subscription, or null when there is none. Real accounts only (C10).

put.summary: Create or replace the own nearby-alert subscription
put.description: Needs a confirmed email. center is stored coarsened by 20-30 m (C6); sending the stored centre back keeps it. radius_km 1-25; paused keeps the subscription without alerts.

delete.description: Stops all nearby alerts; 204 also when there was none.

get.description: Every app_config key with is_public = true, as { key: value } (C1). Cached: `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`.

post.description: Settlements, city districts, streets and house numbers (GURS) for q, best first, at most 5. "Street 5, Settlement" puts the house number first. `Cache-Control: no-store`.
The city district or settlement covering the point with its municipality, else the municipality; null outside Slovenia. Never a street or house number. `Cache-Control: no-store`.

200.description: The place, or null outside Slovenia

get.description: Touches the database. 200 when ready, 503 when the database is down; `queue_lag_s` is null until the job queue exists. Liveness without the database: `GET /ping`.
The own profile including private fields, plus email, email_verified (auth.users.email_confirmed_at), is_anonymous, role and aal (C3).

patch.description: Partial update of the own profile. home is stored coarsened by 20-30 m (C6); sending the stored point back keeps it. The role cannot be changed here.

get.description: ReportOwnerView of every report the caller manages (held, hidden and closed included), newest first, keyset-paginated (`cursor` = the last item id, `limit` ≤ 50).
Newest first, keyset-paginated (`cursor` = the last item id, `limit` ≤ 50); `unread` counts all unread rows.

post.description: `{ ids }` (own rows; other ids are ignored) or `{ all: true }`.

get.description: No sign-in. Verifies the signed token from an alert email and shows a confirm form (HTML, profile language); it writes nothing, so link scanners cannot turn alerts off.

post.description: No sign-in: the signed token (query) from an alert email turns that type email channel off (the confirm form, or an RFC 8058 `List-Unsubscribe=One-Click` POST; the body is ignored) and returns an HTML confirmation in the profile language.

get.description: One item per switchable type (defaults when never set; nearby_lost email is opt-in) plus the quiet hours (set with PATCH /v1/me).

put.summary: Set the channels of one type
put.description: Partial: omitted channels keep their value. manage_link and payment_receipt are transactional (VALIDATION).

post.description: Upsert by token: the token moves to the caller and `last_seen_at` is refreshed.

delete.description: The token travels in the body, never in the URL. Only the caller’s own token is removed.

post.summary: Create a lost, found or sighted report
post.description: Requires `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` (a replay from the same user returns the stored response for 24 h). `location` is the point the client already coarsened; the API coarsens it again by 20–30 m and never stores or returns the received point. Lost reports need a real account. `warnings` may hold OLD_EVENT (event older than 30 days). Starts photo publishing, matching and, for visible lost reports, nearby alerts.

patch.description: Partial CreateReportInput without `type`. No `location`, or the stored point sent back, keeps the stored point; a new point is coarsened anew. `photo_ids` replaces the photos in order. Removed, closed and reunited reports answer GONE.

get.summary: One report by its short code
get.description: PublicReport (fuzzed area; no chip number, contact data or exact point). A manager of the report gets ReportOwnerView. Hidden, removed and reports closed more than 30 days ago answer GONE with `details.reason`.
Active shelters sorted by name; `area` is the statistical region in the request language.
All 212 municipalities sorted by name; `shelter_slug` is null unless the shelter is confirmed.

get.summary: Responsible shelter for a point or a municipality
get.description: `?lat=&lng=` (rounded to 2 decimals by the client) or `?municipality=<slug>`. Only `confirmed` names the responsible shelter; `likely` is unconfirmed; `unconfirmed` lists up to 2 nearest shelters without a phone.
An active shelter with its confirmed municipalities; 404 for an unknown or inactive slug.
